demos.name: QTAU Connector Workbench
demos.description: Runnable examples for QTAU Connector Workbench. The first two examples run entirely offline (no QTAU FastAPI server needed); the third demonstrates the programmatic-API flow against a running backend.

demoitem.label: Local QEC simulation
demoitem.description: Sweep fidelity vs. depolarizing-noise probability for the 3-qubit bit-flip code. Compare bitflip3 / phaseflip3 / shor9 side-by-side. Inspect the Bloch vector of the recovered logical state.

demoitem.label: Visualize a quantum circuit
demoitem.description: Render an OpenQASM circuit as ASCII, HTML, and SVG using the bundled CircuitDiagram helper. Cycle through the bundled QTAUBench small-circuit subset.

demoitem.label: Programmatic connection and browsing
demoitem.description: Drive the QTAU FastAPI backend from MATLAB without launching the workbench UI. List projects, browse circuits, prepare for scripted bulk operations.
